most_similar_reason: Candidate 4 shares the target's exact core: a snake-bodied brother–sister pair living on a mythic mountain who take an omen (merging flames rather than gathering mist) as divine approval to marry, then create the first humans out of clay, within a cosmology of sky-and-earth separation and culture-founding institutions.
